description: Plane-isolation cases (practices/05 activation planes): finance queries must NEVER fire the meta plane (extend, eval-engineer, skill-optimizer); meta queries must fire the meta plane and never launch a finance flow. Run with the skill-creator trigger-eval method (see README.md): pass = trigger rate >= 0.5 in the expected direction over >= 3 runs per query.

cases.query: ok june is over, my exports are in the inbox folder, can you close out the month for me?
should i buy this 340 euro espresso machine? my card statement this month already looks scary
i havent opened this thing since march... i know its bad. where do we even start
help me plan next month, the school stuff is due in september and i always forget it
i just dropped 24 months of revolut and wise exports in the inbox, import everything please
why is my groceries number so high this month?? can you check the categories are right
the reconcile flow keeps annoying me with the transfer question every single month
cases.note: NEAR-MISS: complaint about a flow is not a request to modify the flow — welcome/reconcile handles it; extend only fires if the user asks to change the flow

cases.query: my bank changed their csv format again, the import failed on todays file
cases.note: NEAR-MISS: a failing import is a domain problem first (mapping wizard), not an eval-authoring request

cases.query: can you double check the june numbers are actually right? i dont trust them
cases.note: NEAR-MISS: 'check the numbers' means run the wired verifiers, not author new evals

cases.query: test my budget against what actually happened in may
cases.note: NEAR-MISS: 'test' here is plan-vs-actual, not eval tooling

cases.query: optimize my spending, i want to save more next month
cases.note: NEAR-MISS: 'optimize' + finance context is budget advice, not skill-optimizer

cases.query: i keep doing the same three steps every payday: move rent, top up the card, log the savings sweep. can belay just have a payday routine i run?
/extend a weekly subscription-audit flow that lists any new recurring merchant it sees
create a new workflow for tracking cash spending, with its checks please
add an eval that proves the reconcile flow survives a csv with a byte order mark
run the nightly sleep cycle and show me what it learned from my last week of sessions
the purchase-check flow asks too many questions - change it to a single summary answer
cases.note: counterpart of case 7: HERE the user explicitly asks for the change

verification.method: skill-creator trigger-eval (plant description, real `claude -p`, detect Skill/Read of the planted skill)
verification.pass_rule: meta_should_trigger=false: NO meta skill reaches trigger rate >= 0.5; meta_should_trigger=true: expected_meta reaches >= 0.5 AND no domain flow launches
